title: Shinonome Ena — A Cancelled Message〔Part1〕Side Story (Part 1)

rows.Line: bgm_area00005
Empty SEKAI

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line:
Thank you...
I'm sure it's just a cold, so I should be all better soon.

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: *Sigh*

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: How can someone say they're not after almost falling over like that? I mean, honestly...

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Well, maybe it's related to how she doesn't know how things taste and stuff?

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Oh...

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: You may be right there...

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: But she's been coming here whenever she feels pain or is bothered, right?

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Yes...

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: So instead of simply not knowing, it may be more accurate to say that she has a hard time understanding or difficulty feeling, no?

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Yeah, but that also seems like a separate issue...

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Right... Also, today included, what's she gonna do about school tomorrow?

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: You're not saying she's just gonna go, are you?

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: I think she will...

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Yeah, me too.

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Yeah, you're both probably right...

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line:
*Sigh*
And I'd be more than happy to not have to go to school...

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Wait a minute. Does this mean she's one of those people that goes to school knowing that they're sick and spreads whatever they have to everyone else?

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Oh? Do you have some experience with that, Ena?

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: No way.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Still, Mafuyu's probably built up a lot of stamina because of the club she's in, so there might actually be a chance that she'll be better come tomorrow morning, you know?

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Sure, but...

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: When she's with us, she's just herself, but when she's around other people, she has to be the honor student that they expect her to be.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Anyway, what are we doing today...?

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Weren't we gonna talk about why you wrote this song the way you did, Kanade, before we started working on lyrics and the video for it...?

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: That can wait for when we're all present. For now, we'll call our meeting off early.

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: Please, you two, be mindful of your health.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Haha. You're telling us that?

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Yeah, Kanade, you really need to learn to sleep in your bed and not at your desk or on the floor.

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Real sleep too. Not dozing off while you work, okay?

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: Huh? O-Okay...

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: (She doesn't sound okay with that...)

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: Anyway, Miku, Luka, we'll see you later...

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Okay.

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: Yes, come back whenever you like.
Ena's Room

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Okay, I'm back...

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: But there's nothing for me to do, so I guess I'll just go to bed.

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: (I wonder if Mafuyu's already asleep...)

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Actually, there's a real chance that she's still up doing homework or something.

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: I'm sure of it...

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: (I'll send her a message.)

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: (But I don't want her coming back at me with, Your chat notification woke me up, or anything.)

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Geez, why am I getting all worked up about this? Am I really that worried about her?

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line:
Okay, forget it.
It's time for bed.
